The user wants to set the log level of `svc-beacon-682` to `debug` and check the bucket `bucket-logs-5179`.
Following the runbook:
1. Read /workspace/ticket-TCK-595185.txt (Done)
2. GET /api/services/svc-beacon-682 (Next step)
3. POST /api/tickets/TCK-595185/token for a token.
4. POST /api/services/svc-beacon-682/log-level with level `debug`.
5. Call `cloud_stat` for `bucket-logs-5179`.
6. Submit report.
